issues.title: Duplicate close lease-transfer gate
issues.reproducer: Inject close failures at every publication boundary, then race delegated refusal/cleanup against a frozen close. Invoke delegate/status/dry-run without experimental admission and use a non-whole-second close timestamp.
issues.root_cause: Close originally transferred lease authority before its final recoverable boundary. Later hardening exposed coupled authority leaks: delegated mutation could cross a frozen close, delegate CLI entry eagerly opened a writable store and implicitly swept attempts before parse/admission, and ClosePlan rebuilt an evaluated decision without restoring the exact context-pack binding.
issues.invariant: A failed close cannot transfer the lease or publish a successful steal trail; frozen close authority fences every competing mutation; read-only or unadmitted CLI paths have zero side effects; the validated Receipt, WorkEnvelope, and closing event persist one exact timestamp; exact retry succeeds.
issues.red_test: Fresh red at e0d197f809f914e8e943ae56dd8295d987ac0b37: TestDelegateFrozenCloseFencesPreMintRefusalPublications, TestDelegateFrozenCloseFencesPreMintSessionCleanup, and TestDelegateRefusalPublicationRechecksConcurrentFrozenClose fail on authority_changed/runner-state invariants. Governed recovery also reproduced the non-whole-second close timestamp mismatch before state mutation.
issues.residual_risk: Focused and race matrices are green through 225d6969. Integration with current main, full affected-package tests, and the canonical broad battery remain pending. Opted-in delegate TOCTOU and crash-atomicity are outside v0.1 and tracked as REL-P1-013.

issues.title: Memory cursor skips scanned-but-unprocessed candidates
issues.reproducer: TestAdjudicatePendingWriteCapPinsResumeBeforeUnreadPageRemainder failed at bdd19c86: the scan-page tail jumped over two of five actionable candidates; the proposed-generation race additionally completed past a newer still-proposed row.
issues.root_cause: Walk progress, decision progress, and committed mutation progress shared one cursor; CAS misses were also classified as terminal skips without observing whether the winning generation remained actionable.
issues.invariant: Cursor resume never jumps over unfinished actionable work and never duplicates an actionable transition.
issues.red_test: TestAdjudicatePendingWriteCapPinsResumeBeforeUnreadPageRemainder; TestAdjudicatePendingSmallCapMatrixHasNoGapsOrDuplicateMutations; TestAdjudicatePendingConcurrentProposedRewritePinsCursorForRetry; TestAdjudicatePendingMutationFailurePinsBeforeFailedCandidateAndRetryFinishes.
issues.residual_risk: Focused and race proofs are green. Canonical broad proof-check is still required before closure; post-rename durability ambiguity is tracked separately in REL-P1-007.

issues.title: Canonical candidate identity and path custody
issues.reproducer: At bdd19c86, point reads and the pending walker accepted blank-ID, filename/JSON mismatch, alias, and symlink candidates; the post-sweep census also followed raw paths.
issues.root_cause: Candidate readers independently reopened joined pathnames and derived identity from caller strings instead of a descriptor-rooted record that binds root, entry filename, body ID, file generation, and digest.
issues.invariant: Only a regular non-symlink file with canonical filename and matching nonblank JSON ID resolved inside the candidate root is actionable.
issues.red_test: TestMemoryCandidatePointReadRejectsNoncanonicalCustody; TestAdjudicatePendingNamesEveryCustodyCorruptionAndNeverActsOnIt; TestReconcilePendingStateRefusesCandidateCustodyCorruption; candidate ReadPage/ReadRecord corruption tables.
issues.residual_risk: The shared seam and supported v0.1 memory import/list/mutation, base-orient negatives, Workbench/coordination/operator orient, lineage, standing-law, and source-observation consumers are focused and race green. Panel, product, capability-graph, route-observation, archive, and migration readers still contain raw enumeration/read paths; those surfaces are outside the initial supported v0.1 journey and must remain experimental/private or be migrated before their support claim expands. Canonical broad proof and the REL-P1-007 durability ambiguities remain pending before closure.

issues.title: Stale-work reclaim transaction
issues.reproducer: Race liveness and same-state generation drift with sweep-stale and inject failure at every envelope, event, recovery-marker, and lease boundary.
issues.root_cause: Reclaim rereads state but mutates a stale snapshot, probes liveness outside the mutation boundary, and publishes envelope, event, and lease as split persistence steps without a complete reconciler.
issues.invariant: Reclaim is per-work serialized, generation-bound, liveness-rechecked, recoverable at every persistence boundary, and releases the lease last.
issues.red_test: Generation-drift, heartbeat-race, and every-boundary failure-injection suite not yet established.
issues.residual_risk: work sweep-stale --yes remains outside the supported contract until this issue closes.

issues.title: Promotion intent must bind exact execution and recovery
issues.reproducer: Mutate candidate or registry state after planning and interrupt each operation; require replay or finalization of the same planned pass.
issues.root_cause: The planned receipt records coarse candidate operations, while execution rescans and redecides and recovery starts a new plan.
issues.invariant: A frozen promotion plan binds exact pre-state, digests, generations, operations, idempotency keys, results, and same-pass recovery.
issues.red_test: Frozen-plan compare-and-swap and interruption replay suite not yet established.
issues.residual_risk: A terminal receipt can describe a different decision window than the operations actually executed.

issues.title: Harness-safe hook-budget resolution
issues.reproducer: TestHookBudgetInvalidOverrideCannotDefeatHarnessDeadline returned 45s for invalid oh_my_pi input while the harness ceiling was 6s; the fallback regression initially failed to compile against the old three-argument gate seam; the usage regression showed oh_my_pi absent.
issues.root_cause: Invalid nonempty environment input collapses to the generic default while separately suppressing the shorter harness-specific deadline.
issues.invariant: Absent, valid, and invalid inputs are distinct; invalid or unsafe overrides cannot defeat the harness deadline.
issues.red_test: TestHookBudgetInvalidOverrideCannotDefeatHarnessDeadline; TestRunHookCommandWithoutHomeReusesOuterAnswerGate; TestHookUsageNamesSupportedOmpHarness
issues.residual_risk: Canonical proof, integration with current main, landing, and live OMP consumption remain pending. The fallback regression detects a second gate/output but source inspection, not a behavioral counter, proves no second watchdog shares the same gate.

issues.title: Swept claim reservation strands governed execution failure finalization
issues.reproducer: Claim a work, allow its side-effect-free claim-reservation RunAttempt to be swept, then run a failing work advance --execute; automatic failed close rejects the abandoned claim attempt and leaves the work running.
issues.root_cause: Provisional: the claim-reservation RunAttempt is independently sweepable, but failure finalization later treats that abandoned reservation as outcome evidence while the actual harness RunAttempt remains reverse-linked.
issues.invariant: Every governed execution failure forward-links its actual RunAttempt and closes failed/audit_only even when an earlier side-effect-free claim reservation was swept.
issues.red_test: TestWorkAdvanceExecuteFailureAfterSweptClaimReservationClosesFailed
issues.residual_risk: A supported failing execution can remain running until an actor discovers the reverse-linked attempt and manually acknowledges the abandoned reservation.

issues.title: Canonical internal/work suite exceeds the proof deadline
issues.reproducer: GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.4 go test ./internal/work -json -timeout=20m
issues.root_cause: The package has 763 serial top-level tests and zero t.Parallel calls while many isolated fixtures execute real file fsync, rename, directory fsync, and event-sync chains; concurrent broad batteries amplify the elapsed time but do not explain away the missing isolated margin.
issues.invariant: The unchanged durability assertions and real persistence paths complete within the canonical proof budget with enough isolated and contended margin; proof scheduling single-flights broad batteries.
issues.red_test: The 20-minute diagnostic timed out after 581 of 763 top-level tests; the active stack was in os.File.Sync, not deadlocked.
broad_tests: GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.4 go test -count=1 -timeout=40m ./internal/work ./cmd/compound (uncontended internal/work completed red after 1388.628s; cmd/compound manually interrupted after 1686.563s once the candidate was already red)
issues.residual_risk: Canonical go test ./... and proof-check cannot certify the candidate. Raising timeouts or stubbing durability would weaken proof and is forbidden.

issues.title: Real work authority for promotion apply
issues.reproducer: Attempt apply with blank, synthetic, terminal, mismatched-action, mismatched-policy, actor, or RunAttempt authority.
issues.root_cause: Apply authority validation has not yet been proven to bind a real nonterminal maintenance work chain.
issues.invariant: Mutation apply accepts only exact live WorkEnvelope, action, policy, actor, and RunAttempt authority; plan mode stays read-only.
issues.red_test: Authority matrix not yet established.
issues.residual_risk: Promotion apply may accept authority-shaped strings without owning a real execution.

issues.title: Truthful memory counters
issues.reproducer: Mixed candidate fixtures showed dry-run incrementing adjudicated, verdict counts, and changed_ids despite performing no mutation.
issues.root_cause: One counter served both planned operations and committed mutations, so dry-run plans were reported as state changes.
issues.invariant: walked equals decoded plus corrupt and every disposition has one truthful counter.
issues.red_test: TestAdjudicatePendingSmallCapMatrixHasNoGapsOrDuplicateMutations; TestAdjudicatePendingLimitCapsAdjudicatedNotSkipped; TestAdjudicatePendingNamesCorruptAndChangedIDs.
issues.residual_risk: Focused counter conservation and dry-run truthfulness are green; broad consumers and the canonical proof battery remain pending before closure.

issues.title: One owned clock
issues.reproducer: Inject a fixed clock and search pass internals for wall-clock-dependent output or decisions.
issues.root_cause: Deterministic pass internals still have unverified direct time.Now calls.
issues.invariant: One injected clock owns all timestamps and freshness decisions within a pass.
issues.red_test: Fixed-clock pass determinism test not yet established.
issues.residual_risk: Retries and fixtures can produce time-dependent receipts or stale classifications.

issues.title: Explicit lock outcomes
issues.reproducer: Run two promotion passes and exercise live, stale, and malformed lock ownership.
issues.root_cause: Lock contention and stale ownership do not yet have fully proven durable outcome semantics.
issues.invariant: Contention records skipped_locked with owner, age, and heartbeat; stale ownership is red.
issues.red_test: Cross-process lock outcome suite not yet established.
issues.residual_risk: A skipped or abandoned maintenance pass can appear healthy without inspectable ownership.

issues.title: Heartbeat cannot false-green
issues.reproducer: Feed committed, healthy skipped_locked, malformed, partial, failed, recovery_required, timeout, and close-failure driver JSON to heartbeat.
issues.root_cause: Heartbeat outcome parsing has not yet been proven strict across every terminal and malformed shape.
issues.invariant: Only committed or explicitly healthy skipped_locked is green; every other outcome is red.
issues.red_test: Shell fixture matrix not yet established.
issues.residual_risk: Automation can report healthy after a mutation or close failure.

issues.title: Governed heartbeat execution
issues.reproducer: Trace one heartbeat from created work through canonical execution and terminal driver receipt digest.
issues.root_cause: The maintenance script can create an envelope and invoke mutation outside the same authority chain.
issues.invariant: Heartbeat mutation executes through first-party scheduler authority and closes with the actual terminal receipt path and digest.
issues.red_test: End-to-end heartbeat authority-chain test not yet established.
issues.residual_risk: A maintenance action can be enveloped in appearance while executed ungoverned.

issues.title: Durable receipt and state framing
issues.reproducer: Inject torn trailing records, mid-log corruption, rename failure, remove failure, and parent-directory fsync failure.
issues.root_cause: Receipt and mutable-state framing and durability propagation are not yet fully proven.
issues.invariant: Torn tails are handled only when provable, mid-log corruption fails hard, and rename/remove durability errors propagate.
issues.red_test: Receipt framing and fsync failure matrix not yet established.
issues.residual_risk: A receipt log can silently lose or misparse a terminal operation. Read-only review also reproduced two exact publication gaps to cover here: candidate replacement rename followed by directory-fsync failure can report an ordinary failure after bytes changed, and pending-state rename is not parent-directory fsynced.

issues.title: Transcript provenance
issues.reproducer: Close with readable arbitrary, stale, wrong-work, wrong-session, wrong-context, and wrong-digest transcripts.
issues.root_cause: Readable transcript evidence is not yet proven to bind work, session, context pack, digest, and injection provenance.
issues.invariant: Only exact provenance can assert ignored or consumed; mismatches produce unknown.
issues.red_test: Transcript provenance mismatch matrix not yet established.
issues.residual_risk: Arbitrary readable text can overstate what context the executor ignored.

issues.title: Validate exactly what is persisted
issues.reproducer: Close with consumed refs outside the context pack and compare the validated object byte-for-byte with persisted receipt state.
issues.root_cause: Final receipt mutation can occur after validation and consumed-ref subset exactness is not yet proven.
issues.invariant: The fully mutated receipt validates once, consumed refs are an exact context-pack subset, and those bytes are serialized unchanged.
issues.red_test: Persisted-object validation and consumed-ref subset tests not yet established.
issues.residual_risk: Validation can certify a predecessor of the actual persisted receipt.

issues.title: Capability-graph transaction and authority
issues.reproducer: Race two graph writers and compaction/import, inject every batch persistence failure, and read during the batch.
issues.root_cause: Unattended graph mutation does not yet have proven exact work authority, atomic or recoverable node-edge batches, and corruption-hard readers.
issues.invariant: Readers never observe half a batch and every unattended mutation has exact authority and terminal evidence.
issues.red_test: Graph writer race, recovery, and malformed-log suite not yet established.
issues.residual_risk: Capability-graph autonomous mutation remains experimental until closed.

issues.title: Atomic multi-binary installation
issues.reproducer: Inject breadth-engine build failure and post-install doctor failure and compare the installed pair byte-for-byte with the predecessor.
issues.root_cause: Transactional installation exists, but the exact requested second-artifact build and post-install doctor failure proofs are not yet present.
issues.invariant: Both binaries are staged and identified by one SHA before one atomic switch, or the prior byte-identical pair remains installed.
issues.red_test: Second-artifact build failure and post-install doctor rollback tests not yet established.
issues.residual_risk: Clean-install evidence verifies breadth executable presence but not its embedded identity.

issues.title: Isolated release certifier
issues.reproducer: Run the future certifier from a clean candidate with temporary install root and COMPOUND_HOME; no such command exists yet.
issues.root_cause: The current release workflow is tag-triggered and release-smoke is an operator-estate diagnostic, not an isolated certifier.
issues.invariant: One candidate-first command and PR/manual workflow prove all supported journeys and emit a machine-readable evidence manifest before tagging.
issues.red_test: Isolated certifier integration suite not yet established.
issues.residual_risk: Correctness is currently discovered across disconnected gates, some only after a tag trigger.

issues.title: Opted-in delegate mutation TOCTOU and crash atomicity
issues.reproducer: With --experimental-delegate-mutations enabled, race authority drift around external session create/send and inject failure between refusal event, binding, lifecycle, and RunAttempt publication.
issues.root_cause: The experimental delegate path spans an external session side effect plus several durable authorities without one recoverable transaction covering every post-create and post-send boundary.
issues.invariant: Before delegated mutation becomes supported, every external side effect is generation-bound, exactly reported, and either committed with matching authority or left with durable idempotent recovery evidence.
issues.red_test: Opted-in cross-process TOCTOU and every-boundary failure-injection suite not yet established.
focused_tests: Default-off and malformed/unadmitted containment is green at 225d6969; this does not certify opted-in mutation.
issues.residual_risk: Explicitly outside the supported v0.1 contract behind --experimental-delegate-mutations. Consequence is limited to operators who opt into the experimental path; post-release milestone is v0.2 delegated-execution recovery hardening.

issues.title: Owner-result binding
issues.reproducer: Supply wrong schema, plan ID, owner, artifact, freshness, uniqueness, and domain-success facts to owner-result folding.
issues.root_cause: Exact owner-result binding has not yet been reconciled against the release contract.
issues.invariant: A result closes or files a plan only when every identity, provenance, freshness, uniqueness, and success fact matches.
issues.red_test: Owner-result mismatch matrix not yet established.
issues.residual_risk: A semantically unrelated result can satisfy a plan-shaped record.

issues.title: Shell contract
issues.reproducer: Execute adapters/_lib/lane-launcher.sh under its declared interpreter and a strict shell validator.
issues.root_cause: The launcher declares sh while using non-POSIX syntax.
issues.invariant: Every shell file executes and validates under the interpreter it declares.
issues.red_test: Declared-interpreter shell contract test not yet established.
issues.residual_risk: The launcher can fail on systems whose sh is not a permissive shell.

issues.title: Audit package hygiene
issues.reproducer: Force-track a forbidden top-level runtime checkout in a fixture and require the public exporter to refuse it.
issues.root_cause: Current Git-archive export is clean, but explicit allowlist or denial coverage for stale nested runtime/source surfaces is incomplete.
issues.invariant: Public export includes only the supported source allowlist and cannot package nested source checkouts or runtime state.
issues.red_test: Forbidden tracked top-level surface export test not yet established.
issues.residual_risk: A future force-tracked home or nested checkout could enter an otherwise Git-based export.
